name: Beep
title: justbeepit.com
shortDescription: Beep is designed to enhance the efficiency of web project management by integrating visual tasks directly into the workflow. It is ideal for agencies and freelancers who need to streamline project reviews, collaboration, and delivery. Users can quickly drop comments on live websites, making it easier to gather feedback and act on it promptly.
pros: Enables visual feedback directly on websites
